objective: Freeze a repository-wide contamination boundary and a complete deterministic selection rule before any UCR Time Series Classification Archive catalogue, dataset name, metadata row, archive, record, label, or solver output is accessed.

future_source.name: UCR Time Series Classification Archive
future_source.source_identity_rule: For v0.87, only active_endpoint may be contacted. Execute exactly endpoint_attempts requests under the frozen retry schedule. If none succeeds, fail the lock; fallback to any other endpoint is forbidden without a new preregistration before source access.
future_source.domain_shift: univariate time-series classification represented as numeric tabular features only after byte locking
future_source.endpoint_success_definition: HTTP 200 after no more than maximum_redirects, body length from 1 through maximum_endpoint_response_bytes inclusive, and every redirect/final URL remaining HTTPS on timeseriesclassification.com or www.timeseriesclassification.com
future_source.endpoint_failure_definition: DNS, connection, TLS, redirect-policy, timeout, empty-body, body-size overflow, or non-200 HTTP result; record each attempt outcome without parsing candidate records or labels
future_source.all_attempts_failed: fail v0.87 without accessing the inactive fallback endpoint, changing criteria, or selecting datasets
future_source.endpoint_attempt_execution: execute all three attempts even after an earlier success
future_source.successful_endpoint_attempt_agreement: collect every successful attempt; require identical lowercase SHA-256 body digest and identical NFC-normalized final URL across all successful attempts; disagreement fails v0.87
future_source.authoritative_endpoint_response: after agreement, use the lowest-index successful attempt; record its exact response-body SHA-256 separately as authoritative_root_body_sha256; frozen_source_release is exclusively the canonical complete source-release manifest digest
future_source.endpoint_body_reading: read at most maximum_endpoint_response_bytes plus one sentinel byte; a sentinel byte proves overflow; never classify or parse an overflowing body as successful
future_source.endpoint_connect_timeout_clock: per connection attempt, measured by a monotonic clock from connection initiation until connection establishment; each redirect starts a new connection timeout but remains within endpoint_total_attempt_deadline_seconds
future_source.endpoint_read_timeout_clock: whole final-response body deadline, measured by a monotonic clock from completion of final response headers until the last permitted body byte; chunk receipt does not reset the clock

collect: explicit UCR archive dataset names and source occurrences
audit_protocol.dataset_name_normalization: lowercase alphanumeric tokens joined by hyphens
audit_protocol.blob_decoding: UTF-8 with replacement for invalid byte sequences; binary and archive blobs are not silently skipped
audit_protocol.oversized_blob_policy: fail the audit and record ref, commit SHA, blob SHA, path and byte size
audit_protocol.git_tree_entry_encoding: git ls-tree -r --long -z raw bytes; split entries on NUL and metadata/path on the first TAB; decode path bytes with UTF-8 surrogateescape; Git path quoting is forbidden

eligibility.numeric_series_metadata_only_predicate: true exactly when classification and univariate are true and canonical TRAIN/TEST URL paths end case-sensitively in _TRAIN.tsv or _TRAIN.txt and _TEST.tsv or _TEST.txt; no bytes, records, or labels may be opened

ranking.string_trimming: strip ASCII whitespace characters U+0009 through U+000D and U+0020 at both ends only

canonical_metadata_types.normalized_dataset_name: string already normalized by lowercase alphanumeric tokens joined by hyphens
canonical_metadata_types.train_url: NFC string with only edge ASCII whitespace stripped; otherwise exact official source URL
canonical_metadata_types.test_url: NFC string with only edge ASCII whitespace stripped; otherwise exact official source URL

ranking.canonical_metadata_serialization: JSON object containing exactly canonical_metadata_fields; keys sorted lexicographically; ensure_ascii=false; separators comma and colon without spaces; UTF-8 without BOM or trailing newline
ranking.canonical_metadata_digest: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of canonical metadata serialization bytes
ranking.ranking_serialization: JSON array [NFC/trimmed selection_seed, NFC/trimmed frozen_source_release, normalized_dataset_name, lowercase canonical_metadata_digest]; ensure_ascii=false; separators comma and colon without spaces; UTF-8 without BOM or trailing newline
ranking.rank: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of ranking serialization bytes

byte_lock_only.selection_before_download: deterministically select the top seven metadata-ranked candidates before downloading any candidate bytes
byte_lock_only.selected_file_success: HTTP 200 after no more than selected_file_maximum_redirects, nonempty response bytes not exceeding maximum_selected_file_bytes, and every redirect/final URL remaining HTTPS on timeseriesclassification.com or www.timeseriesclassification.com
byte_lock_only.selected_file_unavailability: fail the entire lock; never substitute a lower-ranked candidate
byte_lock_only.redirect_policy: record every redirect and final URL; a redirect outside the frozen official source hosts fails the lock
byte_lock_only.selected_file_attempt_execution: execute all three attempts for each selected TRAIN or TEST file even after an earlier success
byte_lock_only.successful_selected_file_attempt_agreeme: for each file, require every successful attempt to have identical lowercase SHA-256 body digest and identical NFC-normalized final URL; disagreement fails the entire lock
byte_lock_only.authoritative_selected_file_response: after agreement, use the successful attempt with the lowest 1-based attempt index
byte_lock_only.selected_file_connect_timeout_clock: per connection attempt, monotonic from connection initiation to establishment; each redirect starts a new connect timeout but remains inside selected_file_total_attempt_deadline_seconds
byte_lock_only.selected_file_read_timeout_clock: whole final-response body deadline, monotonic from completion of final response headers to completion of body; chunk receipt does not reset the 120-second clock; redirects do not reset the total-attempt clock

failure_policy.insufficient_future_eligible_candidates: fail the later lock without relaxing criteria
failure_policy.selected_raw_byte_unavailability: fail the later lock after the frozen retry schedule; do not replace the selected candidate

claim_boundary: Repository-only provenance infrastructure and a frozen future selection/ranking/download/gate protocol. The audit may fetch Git branch objects from the project origin under the frozen refspec, but it must not contact any external dataset source. This is not dataset evaluation, fresh external evidence, independent reproduction, peer review, novelty, publication, a world-class result, or a breakthrough.
next_stage: Only after the exact v0.86 registry artifact is preserved may a separate branch access official UCR metadata and execute the frozen metadata-only seven-dataset byte lock.

future_blind_gate.gate_source: exact v0.82 locked gate with future UCR datasets treated as the seven fresh datasets

future_catalogue_parser.html_decoding: strict UTF-8 after optional UTF-8 BOM removal; decoding failure fails v0.87
future_catalogue_parser.url_canonicalization: NFC; edge ASCII whitespace strip; urljoin against page URL; HTTPS only; IDNA-lowercase host restricted to timeseriesclassification.com or www.timeseriesclassification.com; no credentials; port absent or 443; fragment removed; path NFC percent-encoded with percent-triplet hex uppercase; query parse_qsl strict_parsing=true, blank values preserved, pairs sorted by key then value, and re-encoded with UTF-8 percent encoding

crawl.algorithm: breadth-first by depth; lexicographically sorted canonical URL frontier at every depth; each URL fetched once
crawl.traversal_link_rule: same allowed host, HTTPS, no query parameters, and path extension empty, .php, .html, or .htm
crawl.candidate_link_rule: path casefold ends with /description.php and query contains exactly one pair whose key is Dataset and whose value is nonempty; no additional query pairs
crawl.missing_scheduled_page: fail the whole v0.87 metadata lock; never skip
crawl.page_limit_exceeded: fail without changing depth, page limit, or link rules

future_catalogue_parser.candidate_identity: raw Dataset query value NFC/edge-trimmed, then normalized as lowercase alphanumeric tokens joined by hyphens; empty normalization rejects the candidate
structured_metadata_sources: HTML table rows: first cell is label and remaining cells form value
individual visible text nodes containing one colon: left side label and right side value
future_catalogue_parser.field_label_normalization: NFC, casefold, replace every maximal non-alphanumeric Unicode sequence with one ASCII space, trim and collapse spaces
future_catalogue_parser.integer_conversion: accept positive ASCII decimal without separators or valid comma thousands groups; remove valid grouping commas; reject signs, decimals, booleans, zero, leading-zero multi-digit values, and values above 999999999
future_catalogue_parser.train_test_link_rule: canonical same-host HTTPS anchor URL whose path basename casefold matches a dataset prefix followed by _TRAIN or -TRAIN for train, or _TEST or -TEST for test, and then one of .ts, .tsv, .txt, .csv, .arff with optional .gz; alternatively normalized anchor text is exactly train, training data, train file, test, testing data, or test file and the URL has one of those suffixes
future_catalogue_parser.conflict_policy: collect every recognized normalized value; zero values is missing; more than one distinct value rejects candidate; repeated identical values are permitted

derived_fields.univariate: archive_type must normalize to one of univariate_values

future_catalogue_parser.provenance_scan: apply frozen UCI/OpenML/PMLB regular expressions case-insensitively to the entire strict-decoded candidate metadata HTML before field extraction; any match rejects candidate
future_catalogue_parser.duplicate_normalized_name_policy: if more than one distinct candidate description URL yields the same normalized name, reject every row in that name group even when metadata is otherwise identical
future_catalogue_parser.candidate_page_failure: fail whole v0.87 metadata lock rather than skip a discovered candidate page
future_catalogue_parser.source_release_manifest: canonical JSON array sorted by canonical requested page URL; each element is [requested_url, NFC-normalized final_url, lowercase SHA-256 of exact authoritative body bytes]; ensure_ascii=false, compact separators, UTF-8 no BOM/newline; frozen_source_release is lowercase SHA-256 of these manifest bytes
future_catalogue_parser.record_enumeration: after the full crawl and all candidate-page parses complete, sort accepted metadata rows by normalized_dataset_name then description_url; apply contamination/eligibility; reject duplicate names; rank only the remaining rows with the frozen ranking bytes
future_catalogue_parser.source_release_identity: frozen_source_release is exclusively lowercase SHA-256 of canonical source_release_manifest bytes covering every fetched root, traversal, and candidate HTML page; root-body digest is separate
future_catalogue_parser.candidate_result_coverage: exactly one result for every discovered candidate URL, with no omissions, extras, duplicates, or page failures

all_html_page_transport.scope: root, every traversal page, every candidate page
all_html_page_transport.agreement: all successes for a URL must have identical body SHA-256 and canonical final URL
all_html_page_transport.failure: any no-success, disagreement, overflow, timeout, non-200, TLS, DNS, connection, or redirect-policy failure rejects the lock
